races.paceDynamic: Strong early gallop guaranteed with confirmed front-runners Theflyingking, Astelia, Certamen, Hathaways Cottage and Cinnabar Moth all keen to lead in this large 23-runner field. The multiple pace angles will create a fierce battle for position early, stretching the field significantly over this stamina-testing 2m1½f trip. With several front-runners having fade warnings and the sustained gallop likely to catch out those without genuine staying power, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with proven stamina reserves who can capitalise on the expected pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple front-runners engage in early battle and fade from 2f out
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will set up perfectly for hold-up horses like Small Fry and Loyal Touch who can stay on strongly when others tire. Berto Ramirez could also benefit despite his young age if positioned patiently.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the stronger prominent racers can sit just off the pace and avoid the early burn-up
scenarios.body: Angelo Dundee or O'Reilly can use their class and experience to track the leaders before striking late. Ehteyat's recent good form makes him dangerous in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Theflyingking can dictate terms without serious early pressure from other leaders
scenarios.body: His Gordon Elliott training and previous wins suggest he has the class to control the race from the front. Astelia could also prove tough to peg back if getting first run.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so strong that it brings the unexposed runners into play at big odds
scenarios.body: Betty's Glen or one of the other lightly-raced horses could benefit from a true-run race that finds out the exposed runners. The large field creates opportunities for outsiders.

races.paceDynamic: Stay In The Game will lead from the start with minimal early pressure, joined only by the prominent runners Portetta, Truckers Cruising, Grey Gardens and Harley Street who won't apply serious heat. The pace will be steady rather than searching, with the bulk of this 23-runner field sitting midfield or held up behind. With so many hold-up horses and limited early pace, this becomes a sprint from the last hurdle where stamina and a strong finish matter more than early position. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven staying power who can unleash a sustained drive in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows the field to bunch up turning for home
scenarios.body: The large contingent of hold-up horses gets the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks, with the patient riders timing their challenges from deep. Those with proven stamina and strong finishes will overwhelm the modest early leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Hold On
scenarios.trigger: If Stay In The Game and the prominent group maintain a stronger gallop than expected
scenarios.body: The early leaders get enough of a jump on the field to resist the late closers, particularly if some hold-up horses get trapped behind the large field. Those who can travel handily and kick from closer positions will prevail.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the slow early pace creates a messy, stop-start finish where few horses finish strongly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a battle of attrition where position matters more than pure finishing speed, favouring those who can stay closest to the pace. Horses that typically fade may benefit from the reduced tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the pace dynamics create chaos and the favoured horses cancel each other out
scenarios.body: A lightly-raced or improving type finds the perfect storm of circumstances to spring a surprise at big odds. The competitive handicap nature opens the door for an unexpected winner.

races.paceDynamic: He Can't Dance will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a measured tempo over this 3m trip without any early pressure. Timeless Treaty and Kevin's Pride will track in prominent positions behind the leader, while the hold-up brigade of Herja, Huntsgrove, and Love Like This will settle at the rear. With no pace pressure early, He Can't Dance can dictate terms and kick for home when ready, making this a race that strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace throughout.

scenarios.body: The leader will have every chance to dictate from the front and prove hard to peg back up the hill. His recent form shows he's effective when allowed to bowl along in front without harassment.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Timeless Treaty or Kevin's Pride can get first run on the leader.
scenarios.body: The Elliott-trained Timeless Treaty has the class edge and Kevin's Pride has been running well in similar company lately. Either could pick up He Can't Dance if the leader's stamina gives way late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too strong and the front runners tire badly.
scenarios.body: Herja has been running well lately and could benefit from a strong pace collapse. The 6-year-old has shown good finishing kicks when the race unfolds to suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Outsider Shocks
scenarios.trigger: If Lark Walk shows dramatic improvement or Huntsgrove finds his old form.
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old Lark Walk is a complete unknown after a poor debut over fences. Huntsgrove has slipped significantly in the ratings but gets a weight advantage.

races.paceDynamic: Scalpnagoon will likely lead with his known front-running tendencies, potentially joined by Court Canyon who has shown early pace in recent runs. The prominent trio of Staffordshire Knot, Impero, and Cinammon Roll will track the leaders closely, while hold-up horses Takenasred and Astley will need the pace to collapse late. With only one confirmed leader and several prominent runners not pressuring early, this sets up a steady gallop that should build gradually. This tactical setup strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and strike turning for home.

scenarios.body: With his 122 hurdles rating and proven stamina, Scalpnagoon could exploit the tactical race by dictating terms throughout. The prominent runners may leave their challenge too late if he builds a decisive advantage.

races.paceDynamic: Secrecies Of Stone stands alone as the only identified pace-setter in this 9-runner field, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure and establish a comfortable rhythm. With eight hold-up horses behind him, this creates a classic scenario where the front-runner gets an easy lead before the pack closes late. The lack of pace pressure should see moderate splits early, building to a cavalry charge in the final half-mile as the hold-up brigade converge. This race shape heavily favours horses with proven tactical speed and finishing kick over pure stayers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Secrecies Of Stone gets soft fractions and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows him to conserve energy and repel late challengers, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on ground that may not be as testing. His prominent style gives him the perfect tactical advantage in this specific race shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Hold-Up Performance
scenarios.trigger: If the genuine pace kicks in from halfway and creates a strong gallop
scenarios.body: This brings the higher-rated hold-up horses into play, with Tullyveery Lad's OR 115 and recent good form making him dangerous. Hardy Diamond from the powerful Elliott stable also thrives when races develop into a true test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a sprint finish after modest early pace
scenarios.body: Horses with proven finishing kicks benefit when the race lacks a true gallop throughout. Ad Caelum's recent consistent form and Attaboyarchie's tactical speed could be crucial if it develops into a dash from the last.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to handle the tactical nature or jumping
scenarios.body: The moderate pace could suit a horse coming back to form or stepping up significantly. Barrow Ranger gets significant weight relief and has shown glimpses, while the race dynamics might not suit the fancied runners.
